verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the reconciliation part of the story: bank reconciliation with auto-generated reconciliation reports and discrepancy reports, plus direct accountant access to the books and generic custom workflows in Advanced. Nothing shows a month-end close checklist that tracks tasks to completion. Missing for 10: a close checklist/task tracker, accrual tracking, review sign-off/approval tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of a close workflow.
